mapper.select:
SELECT A.DM_ID AS "dmId", A.DM_NM AS "dmNm", A.DM_SYS_CD AS "sysCd", A.DICT_ID AS "dictId", COALESCE(A.MODEL_TYPE, 'PHYSICAL') AS "modelType",
CASE WHEN A.DM_DS_ID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE WHERE DS_ID = A.DM_DS_ID) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "structTargetYn", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED') AS "objCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED') AS "attrCnt", D.TOTAL_CNT AS "totalColCnt", D.ISSUE_COL_CNT AS "issueColCnt", D.END_DT AS "diagEndDt", SD.STRUCT_TOTAL AS "structTotal", SD.STRUCT_DIFF AS "structDiff", SD.ADDED_COLUMNS AS "addedColumns", SD.MODIFIED_COLUMNS AS "modifiedColumns", SD.DELETED_COLUMNS AS "deletedColumns", SD.ADDED_TABLES AS "addedTables", SD.DELETED_TABLES AS "deletedTables", to_char(SD.DIAG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS "structDiagDt" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT J.DM_ID, J.TOTAL_CNT, J.END_DT, COALESCE(IC.ISSUE_COL_CNT, 0) AS ISSUE_COL_CNT FROM TB_DIAG_JOB J LEFT JOIN (SELECT DIAG_JOB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(OBJ_OWNER, '') || '.' || OBJ_NM || '.' || ATTR_NM) AS ISSUE_COL_CNT FROM TB_DIAG_RESULT GROUP BY DIAG_JOB_ID) IC ON IC.DIAG_JOB_ID = J.DIAG_JOB_ID WHERE J.STATUS = 'DONE' AND J.END_DT = (SELECT MAX(END_DT) FROM TB_DIAG_JOB WHERE DM_ID = J.DM_ID AND STATUS = 'DONE') ) D ON D.DM_ID = A.DM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT H.DATA_MODEL_ID, H.DIAG_DT, (H.TOTAL_TABLES + H.TOTAL_COLUMNS) AS STRUCT_TOTAL, (H.ADDED_TABLES + H.DELETED_TABLES + H.ADDED_COLUMNS + H.DELETED_COLUMNS + H.MODIFIED_COLUMNS) AS STRUCT_DIFF, H.ADDED_COLUMNS, H.MODIFIED_COLUMNS, H.DELETED_COLUMNS, H.ADDED_TABLES, H.DELETED_TABLES FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY H WHERE H.STATUS = 'DONE' AND H.DIAG_DT = (SELECT MAX(DIAG_DT) FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY WHERE DATA_MODEL_ID = H.DATA_MODEL_ID AND STATUS = 'DONE') ) SD ON SD.DATA_MODEL_ID = A.DM_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DM_ID = #{dmId} ORDER BY A.DM_NM
SELECT SYS_CD AS "sysCd", P_SYS_CD AS "pSysCd", SYS_NM AS "sysNm", SYS_TP AS "sysTp" FROM TB_SYS_INFO ORDER BY SYS_NM
SELECT DICT_ID FROM TB_DATA_MODEL WHERE DM_ID = #{value}
SELECT DICT_ID FROM TB_STD_DICT WHERE DEFAULT_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DICT_ID LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BATCH_RUN (RUN_ID, RUN_TP, STATUS, START_DT, DM_ID, DICT_ID, SCHEDULE_LOG_ID, CRET_USER_ID) VALUES (#{runId}, #{runTp}, 'RUNNING', to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{dmId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dictId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{scheduleLogId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT STATUS FROM TB_BATCH_RUN WHERE RUN_ID = #{value}

SELECT R.RUN_ID AS "runId", R.RUN_TP AS "runTp", R.STATUS AS "status", R.START_DT AS "startDt", R.END_DT AS "endDt", R.DM_ID AS "dmId", (SELECT DM_NM FROM TB_DATA_MODEL WHERE DM_ID = R.DM_ID) AS "dmNm", R.DICT_ID AS "dictId", (SELECT DICT_NM FROM TB_STD_DICT WHERE DICT_ID = R.DICT_ID) AS "dictNm", R.SUMMARY AS "summary", R.ERROR_MSG AS "errorMsg", R.CRET_USER_ID AS "cretUserId" FROM TB_BATCH_RUN R WHERE R.RUN_ID = #{value}

SELECT R.RUN_ID AS "runId", R.RUN_TP AS "runTp", R.STATUS AS "status", R.START_DT AS "startDt", R.END_DT AS "endDt", R.DICT_ID AS "dictId", R.SUMMARY AS "summary", R.CRET_USER_ID AS "cretUserId" FROM TB_BATCH_RUN R WHERE R.RUN_TP = #{runTp} AND R.DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND R.STATUS = 'DONE' ORDER BY R.START_DT DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMPLIANCE_SNAPSHOT (RUN_ID, SNAP_DT, DM_ID, DM_NM, SYS_CD, DICT_ID, OBJ_CNT, ATTR_CNT, TOTAL_COL_CNT, ISSUE_COL_CNT, STND_RATE, DIAG_END_DT, STRUCT_TOTAL, STRUCT_DIFF, STRUCT_RATE, STRUCT_DIAG_DT) VALUES (#{runId}, #{snapDt}, #{dmId}, #{dmNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sysCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dictId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{objCnt, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{attrCnt, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{totalColCnt, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{issueColCnt, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{stndRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{diagEndDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{structTotal, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{structDiff, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{structRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{structDiagDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO TB_UNUSED_STD_RESULT (RUN_ID, KIND, STD_ID, STD_NM, ENG_ABRV_NM, EXTRA, APRV_YN, CRET_DT) VALUES
(#{runId}, #{kind}, #{r.id}, #{r.nm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{r.engAbrvNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{r.extra, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{r.aprvYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{r.cretDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT STD_ID AS "id", STD_NM AS "nm", ENG_ABRV_NM AS "engAbrvNm", EXTRA AS "extra", APRV_YN AS "aprvYn", CRET_DT AS "cretDt" FROM TB_UNUSED_STD_RESULT WHERE RUN_ID = #{runId} AND KIND = #{kind} AND (STD_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ENG_ABRV_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY STD_NM

SELECT S.RUN_ID AS "runId", S.SNAP_DT AS "snapDt", S.DM_ID AS "dmId", S.TOTAL_COL_CNT AS "totalColCnt", S.ISSUE_COL_CNT AS "issueColCnt", S.STRUCT_TOTAL AS "structTotal", S.STRUCT_DIFF AS "structDiff" FROM TB_COMPLIANCE_SNAPSHOT S WHERE S.DM_ID IN #{d} ORDER BY S.SNAP_DT, S.RUN_ID

SELECT TARGET_TP AS "targetTp", TARGET_ID AS "targetId", STND_RATE_GOAL AS "stndRateGoal", STRUCT_RATE_GOAL AS "structRateGoal", TARGET_DESC AS "targetDesc", UPDT_DT AS "updtDt", UPDT_USER_ID AS "updtUserId" FROM TB_DA_TARGET

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SYS_INFO WHERE SYS_CD = #{targetId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL WHERE DM_ID = #{targetId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DA_TARGET (TARGET_TP, TARGET_ID, STND_RATE_GOAL, STRUCT_RATE_GOAL, TARGET_DESC, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{targetTp}, #{targetId}, #{stndRateGoal, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{structRateGoal, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{targetDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (TARGET_TP, TARGET_ID) DO UPDATE SET STND_RATE_GOAL = EXCLUDED.STND_RATE_GOAL, STRUCT_RATE_GOAL = EXCLUDED.STRUCT_RATE_GOAL, TARGET_DESC = EXCLUDED.TARGET_DESC, UPDT_DT = EXCLUDED.UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.UPDT_USER_ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_DA_TARGET WHERE TARGET_TP = #{targetTp} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId}
